## Severity policy

- **Blocker:** breaks intent, causality, agency, orientation, payoff, canon, power legality, continuity, target-language experience, accessibility, or publication integrity.
- **Revision opportunity:** can sharpen pleasure or meaning without preventing the work from functioning.
- **Rejected finding:** conflicts with higher canon, rests on stale text, or would damage a protected strength. Record why.

## Protected strengths

List the lines, jokes, images, relationships, scene turns, or ambiguities that revision must preserve.

## Closure gate

- [ ] Every blocker was checked against current files
- [ ] Accepted blockers were fixed by one integrated editor
- [ ] Rejected findings record authority and reason
- [ ] Adjacent continuity was rechecked
- [ ] A current delta reviewer verified each fix
- [ ] Full mechanical and rendered release gates were rerun after the last change
